_note: PRD v5 R9: YouTube research and production planning (`ca youtube`, skill make-youtube). Separate from the social workflow; shares only the registry (BG IDs, approval), storage, tracker and authorization layers. Roman records, the editing agency (Takwa) edits; the system never renders a video. Formula: config/formulas.json youtube_longform (the 8-step storytelling formula, R9.6). Length: Q4 default 10-12 minutes, about 1,300-1,600 spoken German words (130 words per minute); a script outside it is a warning, not an error, until Roman confirms Q4.

editorialFocus._note: Persistent editorial preference; monthly capacity and approval gates remain unchanged.
priorityThemes: situations where AI appears out of control
harm caused by incorrect AI use
documented German problems AI could help solve
avoidUnlessRequested: business growth topics without a documented German societal problem
editorialFocus.sourceRule: Use current, opened sources and do not claim AI will solve a problem unless the evidence supports it.

A.name: Investigativ
A.approach: Start with a real, documented incident; uncover its causes and consequences step by step, like an investigation; end with what companies and people should do now.

B.name: Direkte Warnung
B.approach: Start with the immediate risk or a direct question to the viewer; give the evidence quickly; spend the most time on the practical response.

C.name: Menschlich
C.approach: Start with a realistic everyday or workplace scenario, clearly framed as illustrative ("Stellen Sie sich vor ..."); tie it to the verified facts and end with solutions. Never present the scenario as a real event and never as something Roman experienced.

similarity._note: the free difference check between two styles: share of shared word trigrams in the openings and in the whole scripts; above the limit the pair is flagged as too similar
